# Sanitized capture projections

`capture-dom.json.gz` decompresses to a JSON array of 27 objects with `name`, `source`, `source_sha256`, `html`. Source paths and SHA-256 bind each case to the privately supplied lecture ZIP. Only the structural portions used by the extension remain. Message text, image labels and IDs are replaced; scripts, event handlers, sidebar history, credentials, resource URLs and signed links are absent. Semantic attributes and hidden state are preserved.

`capture-network/` is the complementary allowlist-only network projection. It preserves normalized backend endpoint templates, request/response field-and-type shapes, SSE/WebSocket event semantics, aggregate counts, state metadata and source hashes. It deliberately contains no captured header values, cookies, query strings, scalar payload values, signed URLs, message text, timestamps, or raw frame contents. See `docs/public-capture/README.md` for the publication policy.

The raw archive is never committed. `scripts/build-public-capture.py` / `scripts/build-public-dom.py` verify its private manifest before deriving the public projections, and `scripts/audit-public-capture.py` fails CI on credential/PII patterns or executable/network-bearing DOM. Expected DOM outcomes remain independently enumerated in `tests/browser/test_browser.py` from source inspection rather than calculated using the adapter under test. Additional synthetic interaction scenarios test behavior that a static snapshot cannot establish.
